architecture: MuseGlimmerForConditionalGeneration (text_config model_type muse_glimmer_text); dense GQA with per-layer sliding/full dispatch

scope.vision_tower: model.vision_tower/model.vision_adapter/model.vision_projection out of scope by contract (809 tensors; not served)
scope.speculation_note: docs/archive/DFLASH2_ADOPTION_SPEC.md names muse as a DFlash2 sidecar target; this contract covers greedy decode only and keeps the embedding norm a runtime step (unmergable) so a draft module stays possible

sources.status: warm copy complete on sparkc (56G, PUBLISHED marker, verified 2026-09-10); digests frozen in digest_freeze

modeling_reference.pin_note: commit was mispinned as the HF model revision 4177486a; corrected to the transformers commit the file sha256 verifies against (validation PINS.txt, byte-identical on fetch 2026-09-09); local copy re-hashed identical at V1
modeling_reference.diff_before_V1_law: satisfied at V1: local copy sha256 equals the PINS-verified upstream sha256

hybrid_attention.rope_rule: theta 5e5 on sliding layers only; all 13 full-attention layers are NoPE (layer_rope_theta[i]==0 iff layer_types[i]==full_attention)

attention.query_rows_note: fused per-rank qgkv carries q(256)+sigmoid output gate(256) rank-local; output gate is elementwise over (head,dim), NOT per-head scalar
attention.qk_norm: scale-less per-head RMS over 128 dims, eps 1e-05, no weight
attention.qk_scale_factor_order: q = bf16(qk_norm(q)) * 3.87 rounded to bf16 BEFORE rope; k unscaled; softmax scale is head_dim**-0.5 applied to q.k

norms.centered_form: y = bf16(rms_f32(x) * (1 + w)); weight stored as the zero-centered delta
norms.final_norm: plain weighted RMS (MuseGlimmerRMSNorm with_scale=True): y = bf16(rms_f32(x) * w); NOT centered per the pinned modeling source
norms.scale_less_norms: qk norm (32 heads x 128) and embedding norm (1 x 6656) carry no weight tensor
norms.embedding_norm: runtime step, never folded into the embedding matrix (DFlash2 draft path needs the raw embedding)

lane_pack_policy.norms: fp32 internal, single bf16 round at the output (q rows get the HF-exact second bf16 round through the 3.87 epilogue)

tokenization.note: tokenizer files freeze with the warm download; token ids in this contract come from config.json
